row.summary_en: A preprint platform with new submissions and revisions organized by subject. Used to track primary research on quantization, pruning, distillation, low-rank factorization, language models and KV cache compression.

row.review_note_zh: 5个recent分类本轮均可读；RSS地址按官方说明改为rss.arxiv.org。另核对17条既有arXiv参考，修正12条论文身份错链；这是入口/身份核对，不是所有论文全文审阅。
row.review_note_en: Five recent-category indexes readable; RSS URLs follow official rss.arxiv.org guidance. Twelve identity mismatches corrected among 17 paper references; not full-text review.

row.review_note_zh: v0.5.22 · 2026-10-19 · 正式发布。关注HiSparse与EAGLE/MTP组合、上下文并行及推测解码正确性修复。博客本轮读取失败，发布页可用；性能需按对应负载核查。
row.review_note_en: v0.5.22, Oct 19: stable release; inspect HiSparse/MTP composition, context parallelism and speculative-decoding correctness. Blog fetch failed; release notes are available.

row.summary_en: A technology-news AI section covering models, chips, startups and industry events. Why selected: Adds chip, deployment and business-cost developments; product news is not evidence of compression performance.
row.summary_zh: 科技新闻媒体的人工智能栏目。用于发现模型、芯片和商业部署变化，并判断它们是否改变压缩需求或落地条件。新闻报道本身不作为压缩效果的实验依据。

row.summary_en: NVIDIA’s LLM inference library, with code, support documentation and release records. Used to compare low-precision and KV optimization implementations and check configuration requirements, hardware limits and version changes.
row.summary_zh: NVIDIA 大语言模型推理库，提供代码、支持文档和版本记录。用于对照低精度与 KV 优化的实现进展，并核对配置要求、硬件限制和版本变更。
row.review_note_zh: v1.4.0rc1 · 2026-10-22 · 候选版。包含NVFP4检查点适配与默认KV cache manager V2；注意破坏性变更和已知问题，不将候选版称为生产稳定版。
row.review_note_en: v1.4.0rc1, Oct 22: candidate with NVFP4 checkpoint support and KV cache manager V2 default; breaking changes and known issues still apply.

row.summary_en: DeepLearning.AI’s AI newsletter summarizing research and industry news. Why selected: A weekly industry digest helps discover omissions; retain only efficiency and inference-compression content.
row.summary_zh: DeepLearning.AI 的人工智能资讯周刊。用于补充研究和产业变化的周度线索，筛选模型效率与推理成本相关内容后回溯原始材料。
row.review_note_zh: 复查已取回公开入口样本，但尚未核对最新一期全文；入口可读不等于当期文章已经完整采集。
row.review_note_en: Public endpoint sample retrieved on recheck; latest issue full text remains unreviewed. Reachability is not complete issue ingestion.

row.summary_en: Together AI’s official technical blog about model serving and inference engineering. Why selected: First-party inference-engineering material adds practical limits of compression and serving deployment.
row.summary_zh: Together AI 的官方技术博客，介绍模型服务与推理工程。本专题关注一手推理工程材料，补充模型压缩和服务落地的实际限制。

row.summary_en: An open-source LLM serving project with code, documentation and release records. Used to track quantization, KV cache and sparse-compute implementations and check hardware and configuration support against its support matrix.
row.summary_zh: 开源 LLM 推理服务项目。通过代码、文档与发布记录跟踪量化、分页 KV 缓存及服务调度实现，作为算法接入和端到端性能评估的工程参照。
row.review_note_zh: v0.32.0 · 2026-10-18 · 正式发布。跟踪低精度后端、KV格式、模型适配与修复；量化算法支持和具体设备可执行性分开核对。
row.review_note_en: v0.32.0, Oct 18: stable release. Track quantized backends, KV formats, model support and fixes; algorithm availability is distinct from device execution.

row.summary_en: The vLLM community’s Ascend NPU plugin. Track version-specific low precision, KV caches, Attention operators and deployment constraints on Ascend, separately from upstream vLLM.
row.summary_zh: vLLM 的昇腾适配项目。重点跟踪量化格式、KV 缓存、模型适配和 Attention 算子的版本变化，用于判断压缩方案是否具备部署入口；与 vLLM 主项目的支持范围分别核对。
row.review_note_zh: v0.30.0rc2 · 2026-10-13 · 候选版。发布说明明确无代码变化，仅修复Docker镜像构建与CANN依赖；不能当作新增量化能力。滚动文档与GitHub发布日期需分别核对。
row.review_note_en: v0.30.0rc2, Oct 13: release candidate with Docker/CANN dependency fixes and no code changes; not a new quantization capability.
